name: tab-sweep
description: Clean up browser tabs and windows that agents or people left open: close finished intermediate tabs, find tabs idle for more than 48 hours, keep anything in use, verify each close. Use when browsers get slow or tab counts grow after research runs. Triggers: "/tab-sweep", "clean up tabs", "browsers are slow", "close old tabs".
